checks.detail: All 13 original corrected predictions are negative; minimum magnitude at common beta104 is -0.00340127945 A. Means 0.8012993015 -> 0.6475533751 A.
17 / 23 original predicted Hchi changes are below zero; the complete scope is 18 HLA and 5 peptide chi-valid sites.
Original scripts/evaluate_itrace_benchmark.py::interface_mask uses structure.backbone[:,1] C-alpha coordinates and query_ball_point cutoff8.0; union is defined before response analysis.
Q72, Gly54, loop means and all ITrace trajectory values agree with independently recomputed contracts. Model outputs and MD are clearly attributed.
Draft does not equate bound-state Hchi with total binding entropy; local contact route is attributed to remodeled sequence and geometry.

issues.finding: The phrase that both betaCDR2 and betaCDR3 are newly increased-contact receptor regions conflates two loops. Primary Table1 betaCDR2 contacts increase 6->38; betaCDR3 decreases36->30.

issues.finding: Cross-state paired beta53 is Ile in WT and Phe only in engineered receptor; naming betaPhe53 for the compared two-state occupancy is inaccurate.

The sequence/geometry -> contact -> two correlated dynamic observations chain is defensible as a mechanistic interpretation. Avoid making Hchi the cause or implying the simulation independently proves a direction.
